node.title: Re: Can not link to "id" in shortcuts
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I think you'll have to use an anchor like instead of an id attribute, and then, from [href://?node_id=43037#general|What shortcuts can I use for linking to other information?]: [href://?node_id=637756#laundry|my pad] becomes [href://?node_id=637756#laundry|my pad].
